purpose: Book-grounded illustration for the Tool section title, coordinated with Shortcuts and Skills. Symbolic study aids, not a scientific figure.

assets.conversion: Lossless WebP; original RGBA PNG retained; no visual post-processing.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent editorial illustration for the title slide 'Tool' in a university workshop about studying the same generative-AI textbook.
Primary request: illustrate practical study tools used to work actively on a textbook chapter.
Subject: one open ivory-paper textbook with a matte dark-petrol cover anchors a compact sculptural group. A small upright tablet emerging above the book displays a simple branching concept map made from a few connected teal shapes. Beside it are two small physical flashcards, a neat study checklist with three ticks, and a simple round study timer without numerals. A warm-orange pencil rests along the open book. These are a small coherent collection of study aids, all visibly related to the same book, not a software dashboard or a hardware toolbox. Pages have only sparse abstract ink strokes, no readable text.
Style/medium: high-end editorial 3D paper sculpture, tactile ivory paper, matte deep-petrol covers and tablet frame, carefully folded layers, refined clean silhouettes, soft realistic shading. Match the existing Shortcuts and Skills title illustrations with their ivory/deep-petrol/teal/warm-orange palette. Slightly elevated three-quarter perspective, consistent perspective across objects.
Composition/framing: portrait 4:5; one centered compact group suitable for the right half of a dark charcoal title slide. Keep every object and the entire open book completely inside the frame with at least 8 percent genuinely transparent clearance around all outer edges. The open book remains the visual foundation, the tablet and study aids form a balanced upper silhouette. No cut-off corners or cropped objects.
Lighting: soft directional studio light, readable against a charcoal background.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no room, no floor, no background rectangle, no vignette.
Text: none; the title is added separately in HTML.
Constraints: no letters, words, numbers, brands, logos, watermark, people, robots, brain imagery, neon or glow. Do not draw a whole slide.
